description: Reserve a Northside Intelligence service project with a non-refundable deposit of 20% of that service's lowest listed price for the buyer's size group (locked 2026-11-08 grid; Solo deposits: personal intelligence setup $115, workflow integration (setup sprint) $195, intelligence audit $320, custom web design $330, tailored intelligence server $650; Small Business and Scaling are higher). The buyer's card is saved and the balance is charged when the service is complete; final price is confirmed after scoping. Returns a checkout_url and order_id; after payment call ni_order_status with order_id.

size_group.description: Buyer size group; defaults to solo. Non-profit and Enterprise pricing are not available through this tool.
